stories.title: Grumpy Finds a Baby
stories.alt: Grumpy holds tiny baby Milo close in the warm family kitchen
stories.description: Ten tiny fingers, ten tiny toes, and the day Milo found his Grumpy.

stories.title: Ruby & Riley’s Dog-Tired Day
stories.alt: Gaga and Milo say goodbye to Ruby and Riley at the front door
stories.description: Missing someone, making your own fun, and one very sleepy family.

stories.title: Ruby, Riley & Goldie’s Egg
stories.alt: Gaga, Ruby, and Riley visit the chickens in the sunny backyard
stories.description: Listening, friendship, and one very special Spanish word.

stories.title: Ruby, Riley & the Hungry Chickens
stories.alt: Gaga finds the chickens pecking in her vegetable garden with Ruby and Riley nearby
stories.description: Hungry hens, helpful dogs, and bugs in the right place.

stories.title: Grumpy Keeps Snoring
stories.alt: Grumpy rests in his chair while Gaga and Milo listen nearby
stories.description: Mysterious noises, a curious boy, and one Grumpy who absolutely does not snore.

stories.title: Ruby, Riley & the Scent of Home
stories.alt: The family gathers in the backyard as Milo carries treats for Ruby and Riley
stories.description: Finding family and knowing exactly where you belong.

stories.title: Grumpy’s Yard Boat
stories.alt: Grumpy, Milo, Ruby, and Riley inspect an old blue boat in the yard
stories.description: A boat that was much better at resting than boating.

stories.title: Milo Makes Room
stories.alt: Milo with Gaga, Grumpy, Riley, and Ruby in a cheerful family room
stories.description: Making space for baby and learning that love grows bigger.

stories.title: The Bridge Across GrumpyLand
stories.alt: Grumpy, Milo, Ruby, and Riley look over GrumpyLand and the river, gate, and bridges
stories.description: Sometimes a gate is more than wood and chain.

stories.title: Gaga Went Away
stories.alt: Milo arrives at Grumpy’s house as Ruby and Riley run to greet him
stories.description: Missing someone, remembering her, and carrying her love.
